newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by blue chips.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher as blue chips gained on burgeoning retail interest and buying by institutional investors, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 20.49 points or 1.25 percent at 1,649.51 on a turnover of 234.6 million taka. Of the 114 issues traded, 56 closed down, 51 ended up and seven were unchanged.
Beximco Pharmaceuticals gained 6.70 taka to 165.86, Bangladesh Tobacco Company was up 17.01 to 269.30 and AMCL Pran shed 55.93 to 1,615.81.
